digest.component_or_area: MCP server configuration and authentication subsystem
propositions: Below-seam ambient config and credential reads in mcp_server.py and _mcp_auth.py must be routed through new owned composition-root resolvers (mcp_gate, compose_config, read_secret_env) added to config.py to enforce approved seams.

Three load_config() per-call reads and two os.environ.get() secret reads currently bypass the composition seam and must be cut to resolve through the seam at startup or per-request composition boundary.
LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS entries for mcp_server.py and _mcp_auth.py must be removed from scripts/config_ownership_exceptions.py such that check_config_ownership.py reports zero findings for these paths.

Per-request resolution semantics and secret-value in-memory handling must be preserved; the cutover introduces no behavioral delta and subsystem behavioral test suites must remain green and unmodified.
